correctness.rationale: PASS: Blokhuis gives nine-point lower bound for nontrivial blocking sets of PG(2,5). Independently compiled and ran new 31-choose-9 complete incidence enumeration (20,160,075 masks): 86,800 blocking, 71,300 trivial, 15,500 nontrivial. Triangle has three unique four-secants, stabilizer signed monomial group of order 24, so all 15,500 nontrivial sets are one PGL3(F5) orbit (group order 372,000). Independent modular row reduction confirms quartic vanishing dimension 6, enumerated all (5^6-1)/4=3906 scalar-form classes, reproduced the complete point-count histogram including exactly 24 with rational zero set equal to triangle; reviewed free 24-element signed monomial orbit code. Independently checked given representative has precisely triangle as rational zeros and its three projective affine chart Jacobian ideals are unit ideals over F5 (geometric smoothness). Hence 15,500*24=372,000 smooth scalar-normalized quartics forming one projective orbit and trivial ground-field stabilizer. Finite enumeration here is exhaustive by 31-choose-9 and 3906 loops; zero-of-gradient over algebraic closure is checked symbolically, not only over F5.
